name: Zotero MetaFlow
shortDescription: 校验、规范并补全文献元数据。
Validate, normalize, and enrich reference metadata.
introduction: 面向需要批量维护文献库的研究者，将字段规范、期刊缩写、在线补全和期刊指标整合到可配置的规则与工具中。
For researchers maintaining a literature library: configure metadata rules, journal abbreviations, online enrichment, and journal metrics in one add-on.
githubDescription: Validate, normalize, and enrich reference metadata. Part of Zotero Flow.
